title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
abstract: arXiv:2611.33625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. translated_title: 状态空间注意力：学习上下文相关的记忆保留
translated_abstract: 标准注意力的键值缓存会随上下文长度线性增长。若要对其加以限制，便会引出一个问题：序列模型在长上下文推理中应当保留什么。我们认为这一选择应当是可学习的，并据此提出了状态空间注意力（SSA），它学习保留一个有界的过去表示集合，并通过标准注意力来读取这些表示。一个学习得到的评分器会依据新到达的上下文以及记忆中的其余内容，对每个块进行重新评分。固定上下文的Transformer由此成为一种特例——即始终保留最近token的情况。我们联合训练评分器与读取器，或者从可微的软记忆加权逐渐过渡到硬性保留，或者从一开始就采用硬性保留。为了给评分器产生训练信号，我们在训练过程中生成监督样本，我们将这一技术称为“恢复”。我们在检索等任务上将SSA与循环模型、有界内存注意力方法以及全注意力Transformer进行了比较。
tldr: 提出状态空间注意力（SSA），通过可学习的评分器自适应地决定保留哪些历史表示以维持有界内存，并配合“恢复”式监督样本训练技术，使模型能够依据上下文动态选择长上下文推理所需的记忆内容。
en_tdlr: State Space Attention (SSA) learns which past representations to retain in a bounded memory through a learned scorer, trained with a novel "recovery" supervision technique, enabling context-dependent memory retention for long-context reasoning.
